act_name: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012 (Copyright Provision)

lines.text: # National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012 (Copyright Provision)

Amended 18 U.S.C. Section 2320, relocating the definition of "traffic" from subsection (e) to subsection (f). This indirectly affected Section 1101(b) of Title 17 (anti-bootlegging), which cross-references that definition.
